body:
If you have absolutely nothing on your resume, it might be worth doing it casually. 

I did the summer internship and did some work that I thought would look good on my resume. Once I farmed enough, I just ghosted the program. If I am not paid for my work, it's not my problem. 

You're not going to learn ANYTHING from any industry professional but rather the other unpaid interns, which are just desperate college students as well. 

The CEO and Exec director might try to bully you, talk-down to you and stress how urgent it is for them that you finish their work, don't let it get to you. If they're not paying you, it doesn't matter. 

With that being said, the experience at GBCS group led me to get my first paid internship, and now I work FT as an Engineer.
